items.project_definition: A synchronization gate ensuring all blocking infrastructure is verified before parallel feature development commences.
The core shared infrastructure layer containing serialization and I/O helpers that block all subsequent user story implementations.
The primary functional objective a user must achieve within a specific feature set.
A sequential alphanumeric token assigned to each entry to ensure unique referenceability.
The lightweight data-interchange format used for persistent storage in the home directory.
The minimum viable product consisting of the first priority user story for basic task creation and completion.
The structural grouping of implementation units by user story to ensure independent testability.
The set of mandatory design documents including plan, spec, and data-model required before coding.
The primary documentation file detailing command-line usage and storage behavior.
The initial phase involving package skeleton creation and tooling configuration in the project metadata file.
The specific implementation unit responsible for providing a clear message when the task collection is empty.
The directory structure for unit and integration verification, validated via quickstart smoke tests.
The process of assigning a timestamp to the creation field during entity instantiation.
The operation that removes all entries marked as finished from the persistent store.
The operation that retrieves and displays all entries in either human-readable or machine-parseable formats.
A high-severity constraint indicating that no feature work can proceed until the current phase is fully completed.
